_techGating: Single credit pool below is the cost of every purchase. Ore is a SOFT tech-gate on top of it (NOT a parallel currency): tier-2/3 structures + key upgrades additionally require an ore component; tier-1 army + all economy need only the wood floor. Full rule + tuning in resources.json → oreTechGate; verified by scripts/economy-check.mjs.

startingConditions._rule: Economically equivalent, not identical. First two minutes of potential income within ~5% across factions.

payback._note: Too-fast payback creates exponential growth; too-slow discourages expansion.

incomeCurveCreditsPerMin._note: Numbers depend on unit pricing; requirement is controlled escalation.

leadBehavior.avoid: small income lead instantly financing more economy with no vulnerability

harassment.rule: A fully unprotected harvester should still die if the raid is not answered.
